race.title: Adare Manor Opportunity Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: DETROIT MAVERICK failed to impress off the bridle at Clonmel 4 weeks ago but he's a major player at this level on his bumper form and earlier placed effort over hurdles. He can get back on track fitted with a tongue tie at the main expense of Keep Kool Coko . DETROIT MAVERICK (IRE) KEEP KOOL COKO (FR) BURNING LIKE FIRE (IRE)
